webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.subtitle: Receive HTTP notifications when events occur in your panel
webhooks.secret_desc: Used to verify the X-JottiCP-Signature header.
webhooks.no_webhooks_desc: Add an endpoint to start receiving event notifications
webhooks.security_text: Every request JottiCP sends to your endpoint is signed using HMAC-SHA256. The signature is included in the X-JottiCP-Signature header as a hex-encoded digest of the raw request body.
webhooks.verify_signature: # Verify the signature in your handler
webhooks.code_sample:
computed = HMAC-SHA256(secret, raw_body)
assert request.headers["X-JottiCP-Signature"] == hex(computed)
webhooks.security_note1: If you leave the secret blank, JottiCP auto-generates a cryptographically random 32-byte secret.
webhooks.security_note2: Rotate secrets by deleting and re-adding the webhook endpoint.
webhooks.security_note3: JottiCP will retry failed deliveries up to 3 times with exponential back-off.
webhooks.security_note4: Each request includes an X-JottiCP-Event header naming the event type.
webhooks.modal_desc: Register a new HTTP endpoint for event delivery
